subject: Operating System
name: Process Synchronization
priorityEvidence: 52 PYQs extracted — highest-PYQ topic in Operating System, tested 1987-2024 almost every year. Builds directly on Process Scheduling's process-state model.

prerequisites.why: Synchronization problems arise from concurrent processes competing for shared resources managed by the scheduler.

unlocks.why: Deadlock (resource allocation) is a direct consequence of synchronization primitives used incorrectly.
